about: Faces painted by Firefly onto the v2 figures' own bald heads (Oct 27, 2026): 12 faces per sex, each with its own expression, front and both three-quarter views. Each piece is an RGBA patch in the same pixel frame as figures/<figure>.png holding only what the face edit changed; lay it on the figure before the hair. Gray beards take the hair color; skin recolors like the body.
